indices: 彼女[01] は 意地悪 女(おんな) だ

original: 嫉妬深い人は、友達にすら、意地悪をして、満足感を得る。

en.text: A jealous person gets a feeling of contentment by behaving like a dog in the manger even with his friends.

indices: 嫉妬深い 人(ひと) は 友達 に すら 意地悪 を 為る(する){して} 満足感 を 得る(える)[01]

original: 本当にトムは意地悪だと思うの？

en.text: Do you really think Tom is mean?
Do you really think that Tom is mean?

original: 人に意地悪して楽しい？

en.text: Do you enjoy being unkind to everyone?
Do you enjoy being mean to everyone?
Do you enjoy being unkind to people?
Do you enjoy being mean to people?
